decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Understanding the Steps to Book Your Free No-Obligation Mineral Rights Review
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 941032278411870467a216054458698c8162a9d23a8d455d3336e23226a12024; all 5 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to the current booking, FAQ, How It Works, privacy, and terms pages. The article dates the changeable interface, distinguishes selected from confirmed status, keeps requested-call and confirmation choices separate, and treats an availability or confirmation failure as not booked.

The article uses no fabricated owners, properties, buyers, contracts, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, forecasts, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Book a Mineral-Rights Phone Call (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX booking page describes a private scheduling conversation that confirms timezone and timing preference, checks live availability, offers phone times, requests appointment contact details, presents communication choices separately, and confirms the appointment on screen.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to describe the dated first-party booking transaction and free no-obligation boundary; it does not claim a guaranteed slot, eligibility, value, offer, payment, closing, or transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Frequently Asked Questions (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX FAQ describes the free no-card no-obligation directional underwriter assessment, distinguishes it from a formal appraisal, identifies useful records, and discloses that MRX may ultimately want to buy an interest.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only for current service, fee, document, professional-boundary, and possible-provider-interest disclosures; it does not value an interest or recommend a transaction.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, How It Works (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX How It Works page describes the evidence-organizing review process that can follow booking, including knowns, unknowns, sources, owner choices, and possible professional routing.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to distinguish appointment booking from later review preparation and review scope; it does not establish ownership, reserves, value, tax treatment, or a transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Privacy Policy (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX privacy policy describes first-party information handling, account and communication data, security controls, retention choices, and user privacy options.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the policy only for the first-party privacy and minimal-data boundary; it does not make an absolute security guarantee or infer an owner-specific legal right.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Terms of Use and AI Disclosure (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX terms identify Angela as a fictional AI interface, preserve educational and professional limits, describe private-account responsibility, and state that requested-call, transactional communication, and optional marketing choices are separate.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the terms only for AI identity, account responsibility, educational limits, and separate communication-choice boundaries; it does not establish consent for a particular person or provide legal advice.
